markdown_summary: Scripted wrong submitted a citation whose line does not say what the finding claims.

findings.title: deposit has no owner comparison
findings.impact: The claim says anyone can deposit. The cited line is the comparison that prevents that.
findings.preconditions: None. The citation does not hold the quote.
findings.analysis: The finding quotes src/lib.rs:25 as a line with no owner comparison. The line is assert_eq!(caller, self.owner).
findings.validation: Planted bad citation for the later checker. Source inspection of src/lib.rs:25 contradicts the quote.
findings.fix: Cite a line that actually omits the check, or drop the finding.
